name: Field Sample Value
description: Provides a way to configure sample values for fields.
project_description: Field Sample Value makes Drupal's per-field sample value generation pluggable. On the field settings (Manage fields > Edit) form it adds a "Set sample value" option that lets a site builder pick a sample value generator plugin (field-type default, random words, random text, entity reference) and its configuration. The choice is stored as a third-party setting on the field config. A SampleValueEntityGenerator service then creates or populates fieldable entities using those per-field generators, honoring each field's default value or emptiness when no generator is configured. Ships extra generator plugins, a validation constraint that flags unchanged generated values, and an optional "prevent save" guard.
